verdict.rationale: Fenwick's Startup Resource Center publishes an 'Incorporation Stage Issues' overview covering common issues founders face at incorporation, and says its resources span 'formation'. That is first-party formation guidance, but the evidence never says it covers choosing an entity type or a jurisdiction, and the listed offices are US-only. missing for 10: explicit entity-type selection guidance, jurisdiction-choice guidance, coverage of UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG and Indian Pvt Ltd, market-specific recommendations, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market

citations.quote: Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview — Common issues startup founders face at incorporation, plus considerations and possible structures for seed financings.

Our startup resource center features articles, videos, checklists, presentations and other tools to help you navigate current challenges and anticipate upcoming issues at every stage of growth, from formation to scaling to preparing for exit.
